name: Leaf-yeast wine
summary: Rượu men lá is leaf-yeast wine. A 2012 feature names it at Ban Ang in the same sentence as love sticky rice and bamboo-tube fish, and also names rượu cần. The two wines stay apart. A strength was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.
origin: Ban Ang. The Vietnam National Authority of Tourism, 26 September 2012.
howToEat: Drink it with the Ban Ang meal. The feature does not say it is the gourd wine.
A strength and the price are Check on arrival.
where: Bản Áng, about 2 km south of the farm town on National Highway 43.
seoTitle: Ruou men la in Moc Chau — leaf-yeast wine
